-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity.

list-contacts.name: list-contacts
list-contacts.description: List contacts from Google Contacts. Returns name, email, phone numbers. Supports pagination.

params.pageSize: Number of contacts per page (default: 100, max: 1000)

get-contact.name: get-contact
get-contact.description: Get a specific contact by resource name.

params.pageSize: Number of results per page (default: 30, max: 30)

list-contact-groups.name: list-contact-groups
list-contact-groups.description: List all contact groups (labels) from Google Contacts. Returns group name, member count, and type.

params.pageSize: Maximum number of groups to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

get-contact-group.name: get-contact-group
get-contact-group.description: Get detailed information about a specific contact group, including its members.

params.maxMembers: Maximum number of members to return (default: 100, max: 1000)

create-contact-group.name: create-contact-group
create-contact-group.description: Create a new contact group (label) in Google Contacts.

params.name: Name of the contact group (must be unique)

update-contact-group.name: update-contact-group
update-contact-group.description: Update an existing contact group (rename it).

params.name: New name for the contact group

delete-contact-group.name: delete-contact-group
delete-contact-group.description: Delete a contact group. This does NOT delete the contacts in the group, only the group itself.

params.deleteContacts: If true, also delete the contacts in this group (default: false)

add-contacts-to-group.name: add-contacts-to-group
add-contacts-to-group.description: Add one or more contacts to a contact group.

params.contactResourceNames: Array of contact resource names to add (e.g., ['people/c123', 'people/c456'])

remove-contacts-from-group.name: remove-contacts-from-group
remove-contacts-from-group.description: Remove one or more contacts from a contact group.

params.contactResourceNames: Array of contact resource names to remove (e.g., ['people/c123', 'people/c456'])

name: Google Contacts
description: Manage Google Contacts - list, search, create, update, and delete contacts, and organize them into groups and labels

changelog.notes: Initial release — list, search, create, update and delete contacts, plus organize them into groups and labels
